releases.name: v0.3.2 — Shorter prompt reminders
releases.body:
Claude Code and Codex now receive a short agile reminder on ordinary prompts, reducing injected text from 7,171 to 153 bytes (about 98%). The full ruleset still loads at session start, after compaction or clear, on reactivation, and when active subagents start. Unreadable prompt input falls back to the full ruleset.

Thanks to @eirvandelden for contributing #1.

Validation: all 47 tests pass; npm package contents checked with `npm pack --dry-run`.
